params.label: Fast SMA
params.title: Length of the fast simple moving average, in bars.

params.label: Slow SMA
params.title: Length of the slow simple moving average, in bars.

params.label: RSI filter
params.title: Only take entries that RSI agrees with.

params.label: RSI overbought
params.title: Block new longs when RSI is at or above this.

params.label: RSI oversold
params.title: Block new shorts when RSI is at or below this.

params.label: Allow shorts
params.title: Trade the short side as well as the long side.

params.label: Execution lag (min)
params.title: Delay between a signal and its fill, in minutes (a multiple of the bar size).

params.label: Cost (bps)
params.title: Trading cost per unit of turnover, in basis points.
